powfacpy.base.folder

Classes for interaction with the PF database. Based on folders from where downstream objects can accessed (see class Folder). The class PFActiveProject inherits from Folder and adds some functionality for the active project.

Also contains the class PFStringManipulation for string manipulation.

The acronym 'PF' is used for 'PowerFactory'.

   1"""Classes for interaction with the PF database. Based on folders from where downstream objects can accessed (see class Folder). The class PFActiveProject inherits from Folder and adds some functionality for the active project.
   2
   3Also contains the class PFStringManipulation for string manipulation.
   4
   5The acronym 'PF' is used for 'PowerFactory'.
   6"""

  36class Folder(BaseObjectStatic):
  37    """Class for interacting with folders in the PowerFactory database (any folder in the hierarchy).
  38
  39    The class is very large and has methods to (you can search for sections):
  40        - Get objects (search for '# Get')
  41        - Create objects (search for '# Create')
  42        - Copy objects (search for '# Copy')
  43        - Delete objects (search for '# Delete')
  44        - Get/set attributes (search for '# Attributes')
  45        - Utils to handle user input etc. (search for '# Handle')
  46        - Utils to handle path strings (search for '# Path')
  47        - Other functionality (search for '# Other')
  48
  49    The class is large to have a convenient interface with a lot of functionality to interact with the PF database (at the cost of the clarity of the code unfortunately).
  50
  51    Note that 'app' is a class attribute, i.e. it is shared by all instances. This is convenient because there is only one 'app' object provided by 'powerfactory.GetApplication()'
  52    """
  53
  54    app: PFApp
  55
  56    def __init__(
  57        self, folder: Union[PFGeneral, str], pf_app: PFApp | None | bool = False
  58    ):
  59        """
  60        Args:
  61            folder (Union[PFGeneral, str]): folder object or path in active project (or in active user if no project is active)
  62            pf_app (PFApp | None | bool, optional): Powerfactory app (returned by GetApplication). Defaults to False (does not default to None because None is returned by GetApplication if something goes wrong; Therefore, None should raise an exception).
  63
  64        Raises:
  65            TypeError: When pf_app is None. See explanation of argument 'pf_app'.
  66        """
  67        if pf_app:
  68            self.__class__.app = pf_app
  69        elif pf_app is None:
  70            raise TypeError(
  71                "The input app is of type 'NoneType'. Maybe the PowerFactory app was not loaded correctly."
  72            )
  73        if not isinstance(folder, str):
  74            self._obj = folder
  75        else:
  76            super().__init__(self.__class__.app.GetActiveProject())
  77            if not self._obj:  # Fallback if no project is active
  78                self._obj = self.__class__.app.GetCurrentUser()
  79            self._obj: PFGeneral = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
  80
  81    @property
  82    def folder_obj(self):
  83        return self._obj
  84
  85    @property
  86    def obj(self) -> PFGeneral:
  87        return self._obj
  88
  89    def __getitem__(self, obj: str) -> PFGeneral:
  90        """Allows to call 'get_obj' (without optional arguments, i.e. subfolders are included) using brackets.
  91
  92        Example: terminals = folder_instance['*.ElmTerm']
  93            where folder_instance is an instance of this class.
  94
  95        Args:
  96            obj (str): Object(s) to search for
  97
  98        Returns:
  99            PFGeneral: Pointers to object(s) from the PF database
 100        """
 101        return self.get_obj(obj, include_subfolders=True)
 102
 103    def __iter__(self) -> Generator:
 104        for obj in self.get_obj(
 105            "*", include_subfolders=False, error_if_non_existent=False
 106        ):
 107            yield obj
 108

 159    def get_obj(
 160        self,
 161        path: str,
 162        condition: Callable | None = None,
 163        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] | None = None,
 164        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 165        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 166    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 167        """Get the PowerFactory object(s) under 'path'. By default, 'path' is relative to 'self._obj' (or the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject).
 168
 169        See also 'get_unique_obj'.
 170
 171        Args:
 172            path (str): path to object(s), can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
 173
 174            condition (Callable, optional): filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110; defaults to None
 175
 176            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder'); defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
 177
 178            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): raise exception if no objects are found; defaults to True
 179
 180            include_subfolders (bool, optional): include subfolders in the search; defaults to True
 181
 182        Raises:
 183            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
 184
 185        Returns:
 186            list[PFGeneral]: List with PF objects
 187
 188        Examples:
 189          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\Terminal 1")
 190
 191        The path can also start with "\\" and contain wildcards after last "\\":
 192          get_obj("\\Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm")
 193
 194        With condition:
 195          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm"",
 196            condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
 197
 198        Note that you can also use "r" at the beginning of the string
 199        argument to use single "\".
 200        """
 201        parent_folder = (
 202            self._obj
 203            if not parent_folder
 204            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
 205                parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
 206            )
 207        )
 208
 209        if not include_subfolders:
 210            try:
 211                obj = parent_folder.GetContents(path)
 212            except RuntimeError:
 213                raise TypeError("Path must be of type string.")
 214        else:
 215            obj = self._handle_inclusion_of_subfolders(
 216                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 217            )
 218        if not obj:
 219            return self._handle_non_existing_obj(
 220                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 221            )
 222        if condition:
 223            obj_with_condition = self.get_by_condition(obj, condition)
 224            if obj_with_condition:
 225                return obj_with_condition
 226            else:
 227                return self._handle_condition_of_obj_not_met(
 228                    path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 229                )
 230        else:
 231            return obj
 232
 233    def get_obj_including_subfolders(
 234        self,
 235        path: str,
 236        condition: Callable | None = None,
 237        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] | None = None,
 238        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 239    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 240        """Call 'get_obj' including subfolders."""
 241        return self.get_obj(
 242            path,
 243            condition=condition,
 244            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 245            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 246            include_subfolders=True,
 247        )

 249    def get_obj_partial(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Callable:
 250        """Partial evaluation of 'get_obj'.
 251
 252        Returns a callable to get_obj.
 253
 254        Example: a = get_obj_lazy("path\\to\\obj", error_if_non_existent=False)
 255                 a() # This calls 'get_obj' with given arguments
 256
 257        For further information arguments etc. see 'get_obj'.
 258        """
 259        return partial(self.get_obj, *args, **kwargs)

 261    def get_unique_obj(
 262        self,
 263        path: str,
 264        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 265        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 266        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 267    ) -> PFGeneral | None:
 268        """Get unique PowerFactory object under 'path'.
 269
 270        Use this method if you want to access one single unique object.
 271        This method is an alternative to 'get_obj' and returns the unique object instead of a list (that needs to be accessed with '[0]'). It also checks whether the found object is unique (only one object is found).
 272
 273        Args:
 274            path (str): path to object(s);
 275            can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
 276
 277            condition (Callable, optional):
 278            filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110;
 279            defaults to None
 280
 281            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 282            specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder');
 283            defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
 284
 285            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 286            raise exception if no objects are found;
 287            defaults to True
 288
 289            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 290            include subfolders in the search;
 291            defaults to True
 292
 293        Raises:
 294            TypeError:
 295            If 'path' is not a string.
 296            If several objects were found.
 297
 298        Returns:
 299            PFGeneral: PF object
 300        """
 301        obj = self.get_obj(
 302            path,
 303            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 304            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 305            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 306        )
 307        if obj:
 308            if len(obj) < 2:
 309                return obj[0]
 310            else:
 311                if parent_folder:
 312                    parent_folder_str = (
 313                        f" in '{self.get_path_of_object(parent_folder)}'"
 314                    )
 315                else:
 316                    parent_folder_str = ""
 317                raise TypeError(
 318                    f"The path {path+parent_folder_str} is not a unique object. Did you use wildcards ('*')? This method only returns single unique objects."
 319                )
 320        else:
 321            return None
 322

 372    def get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
 373        self, parent_folders: Union[list[PFGeneral], str], sub_path: str
 374    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 375        """Get multiple objects that are in a similar subdirectory relativ to
 376        their parent folders
 377
 378        Args:
 379            parent_folders (Union[list[PFGeneral], str]): parent folders
 380
 381            sub_path (str):
 382                path within the parent folders (string). Must be  unique (don't use placeholders '*')
 383
 384        Returns:
 385            list[PFGeneral]: list of PF objects
 386
 387        Example:
 388          If you want to get the "All calculation" objects of all the study cases in the study case folder, use
 389            'self.get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
 390              'Study Cases\\','All calculations')'
 391        """
 392        if isinstance(parent_folders, str):
 393            parent_folders = self.get_obj(parent_folders)
 394        objs = []
 395        for parent in parent_folders:
 396            parent = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
 397            objs.append(self.get_single_obj(sub_path, parent_folder=parent))
 398        return objs

 400    def get_upstream_obj(
 401        self,
 402        start_obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 403        condition: Callable,
 404        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 405    ) -> PFGeneral:
 406        """Get upstream object that meets the condition.
 407
 408        Searches upstream in the PF database hierarchy.
 409
 410        Args:
 411            start_obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional): Object/folder (or its path) to start from
 412
 413            condition (Callable): Condition for the searched object
 414
 415            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): If True, an exception is raised if no upstream object is found. Defaults to True.
 416
 417        Returns:
 418            PFGeneral: The PF object found
 419        """
 420        start_obj_or_path = (
 421            self._obj
 422            if not start_obj_or_path
 423            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(start_obj_or_path)
 424        )
 425        obj_or_path = start_obj_or_path.GetParent()
 426        if obj_or_path:
 427            if condition(obj_or_path):
 428                return obj_or_path
 429            else:
 430                return self.get_upstream_obj(
 431                    obj_or_path, condition, error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent
 432                )
 433        else:
 434            if error_if_non_existent:
 435                raise Exception(
 436                    "There is no upstream object that fullfills the condition."
 437                )
 438            else:
 439                return None
 440
 441    def get_by_condition(
 442        self, objects: list[PFGeneral], condition: Callable
 443    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 444        """Get objects (from a list of objects) which satisfy 'condition'.
 445
 446        Args:
 447            objects (list[PFGeneral]): list of objects
 448            condition (Callable): e.g. lambda function
 449
 450        Raises:
 451            PFAttributeError: If 'condition' queries attributes which an item in 'objects' does not have.
 452            TypeError: ToDo
 453
 454        Returns:
 455            list[PFGeneral]: PF objects
 456
 457        Example:
 458          pfbi.get_by_condition(list_of_objects, lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
 459        """
 460        try:
 461            return [x for x in objects if condition(x)]
 462        except:  # Check where exactly the exception is raised
 463            objects_true = []
 464            for obj in objects:
 465                try:
 466                    # This anonymous function is problematic because it does
 467                    # not always throw an error when the user provided
 468                    # an anonymous function that does not make sense.
 469                    if condition(obj):
 470                        objects_true.append(obj)
 471                except AttributeError as e:
 472                    raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
 473                except TypeError as e:
 474                    object_str = self.get_path_of_object(obj)
 475                    raise TypeError(
 476                        f"{e}. Maybe an unexpected type is used "
 477                        f"for attribute of object '{object_str}'."
 478                    )
 479            return objects_true  # should never be reached
 480

 500    def create_by_path(
 501        self, path: str, overwrite: bool = True, use_existing: bool = False
 502    ) -> PFGeneral:
 503        """Create an object by specifying its path (including the class at the end) and return the object.
 504
 505        Args:
 506            path (str): path including class name at the end.
 507            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite existing object. Defaults to True.
 508
 509        Raises:
 510            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
 511
 512        Returns:
 513            PFGeneral: The created object
 514
 515        Example:
 516          pfbi.create_by_path('Library\\Dynamic Models\\dummy.BlkDef')
 517        """
 518        try:
 519            folder_path, obj_name_incl_class = path.rsplit("\\", 1)
 520        except AttributeError:
 521            raise TypeError("The argument 'path' must be of type string.")
 522        folder = self.get_unique_obj(folder_path)
 523        return self.create_in_folder(
 524            obj_name_incl_class, folder, overwrite=overwrite, use_existing=use_existing
 525        )
 526
 527    def create_in_folder(
 528        self,
 529        obj: str,
 530        folder: PFGeneral | Folder | str = None,
 531        overwrite: bool = True,
 532        use_existing: bool = False,
 533    ) -> PFGeneral:
 534        """Create an object inside a folder and return the object.
 535
 536        Args:
 537            obj (str): obj including class, e.g. 'model.BlkDef'
 538
 539            folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Target folder. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj')
 540
 541            overwrite (bool, optional): objects with the same name will be overwritten. Defaults to True.
 542
 543            use_existing (bool, optional):
 544                If an object with the same name exists, a new object with "(1)"/"(2)".. in its loc_name is created.
 545                If use_existing is True and an object with the same name exists, the method just returns the existing object.
 546                Defaults to False.
 547
 548        Raises:
 549            TypeError: If 'obj' is not a string
 550
 551        Returns:
 552            PFGeneral: The created object
 553
 554        Example:
 555          folder.create_in_folder("dummy2.BlkDef", "Library\\Dynamic Models",)
 556        """
 557        folder = (
 558            self._obj
 559            if not folder
 560            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
 561        )
 562        try:
 563            obj_name, _, class_name = obj.rpartition(".")
 564        except AttributeError:
 565            raise TypeError("The argument 'obj' must be of type string.")
 566        if use_existing:
 567            existing_obj = self.get_unique_obj(
 568                obj, parent_folder=folder, error_if_non_existent=False
 569            )
 570            if existing_obj:
 571                return existing_obj
 572        elif overwrite:
 573            self.delete_obj(
 574                obj,
 575                parent_folder=folder,
 576                include_subfolders=False,
 577                error_if_non_existent=False,
 578            )
 579        return folder.CreateObject(class_name, obj_name)
 580
 581    def create_directory(
 582        self, directory: str, parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None
 583    ) -> IntFolder:
 584        """Create a directory of folders ('IntFolder') if the directory does not exist yet.
 585
 586        Similar to 'mkdir' command in Windows.
 587
 588        Args:
 589            directory (str): path with folders
 590                Example: 'folder1\\folder2\\folder3'
 591
 592            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Folder to start from. Defaults to None.
 593
 594        Returns:
 595            IntFolder: the folder in the lowest subdirectory.
 596        """
 597        if not self.path_exists(directory, parent=parent_folder):
 598            folder = self._obj if not parent_folder else parent_folder
 599            folder_names = directory.split("\\")
 600            for folder_name in folder_names:
 601                if not self.path_exists(folder_name, parent=folder):
 602                    folder = self.create_in_folder(folder_name + ".IntFolder", folder)
 603                else:
 604                    folder = self.get_unique_obj(
 605                        folder_name, parent_folder=folder, include_subfolders=False
 606                    )
 607            return folder
 608        else:
 609            return self.get_unique_obj(
 610                directory, parent_folder=parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
 611            )

 613    def create_filter_obj(
 614        self,
 615        name: str,
 616        folder: str | PFGeneral,

 625        """Create filter object (SetFilt)
 626
 627        Args:
 628            name (str): Name of filter object.
 629
 630            folder (PFGeneral | Folder | str): target folder where filer is created.
 631
 632            object_filter (str): Object/class filter (parameter 'objset'). Class names sparated by commas, e.g. '*.ElmTerm, *.ElmLne'.
 633
 634            look_in (PFGeneral | str): Folder from which search is started (parameter 'pstart').
 635
 636            expression (str): filter expression (parameter 'expr'), e.g. 'uknom>100.and.uknom<380.and.iUsage=0'
 637
 638            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Include subfolders in search. Defaults to True.
 639
 640            only_calc_relevant_obj (bool, optional): Search only for calc. relevant objects. Defaults to True.
 641
 642            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite possible existing filter object. Defaults to True.
 643
 644            use_existing (bool, optional): See description of 'create_in_folder' in 'Folder' class of powfacpy. Defaults to False.
 645
 646        Returns:
 647            SetFilt: Filter object
 648        """
 649
 650        filter_obj: SetFilt = self.create_in_folder(
 651            name + ".SetFilt",
 652            folder=folder,
 653            overwrite=overwrite,
 654            use_existing=use_existing,
 655        )
 656        look_in = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(look_in)
 657        filter_obj.objset = [object_filter]
 658        filter_obj.expr = expression
 659        filter_obj.pstart = look_in
 660        filter_obj.isubfold = include_subfolders
 661        filter_obj.icalcrel = only_calc_relevant_obj
 662        return filter_obj
 663
 664    ##################
 665    # Copy
 666    ##################
 667    def copy_obj(
 668        self,
 669        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str, list[PFGeneral]],
 670        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder],
 671        overwrite: bool = True,
 672        condition: Callable = None,
 673        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 674        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 675        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 676    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 677        """Copy object(s) to 'target_folder'.
 678
 679        Uses 'get_obj' to get the objects under 'obj_or_path'. Source and target must be in the active project (otherwise use PasteCopy(), see scripting reference)
 680
 681        See also 'copy_single_obj'.
 682
 683        Args:
 684            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
 685                Objects to be copied (get_obj is used for strings)
 686
 687            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
 688                Folder to which objects are copied
 689
 690            overwrite (bool, optional):
 691                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 692
 693            condition (Callable, optional):
 694                Condition used in 'get_obj' for the source objects . Defaults to None.
 695
 696            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 697                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be copied. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 698
 699            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 700                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 701
 702            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 703                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 704
 705        Returns:
 706            list[PFGeneral]: Copied objects
 707        """
 708        obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 709            obj_or_path,
 710            condition=condition,
 711            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 712            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 713            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 714        )
 715        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 716        if overwrite:
 717            for object_to_be_copied in obj:
 718                self.delete_obj(
 719                    object_to_be_copied.GetAttribute("loc_name")
 720                    + "."
 721                    + object_to_be_copied.GetClassName(),
 722                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 723                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 724                )
 725        # AddCopy() accepts a list of objects, but then it returns the target folder object and not the copied objects. Therefore, it is iterated through the objects.
 726        copied_obj = []
 727        for o in obj:
 728            copied_obj.append(target_folder.AddCopy(o))
 729        return copied_obj
 730
 731    def copy_single_obj(
 732        self,
 733        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 734        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
 735        overwrite: bool = True,
 736        use_existing: bool = False,
 737        new_name: str = None,
 738        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 739        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 740    ) -> PFGeneral:
 741        """Copy a single PF object to 'target_folder'
 742
 743         Uses 'get_unique_obj' to get the object under 'obj_or_path'. Source and target must be in the active project (otherwise use PasteCopy(), see scripting reference)
 744
 745        See also 'copy_obj'.
 746
 747        Args:
 748            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
 749                Object to be copied (get_unique_obj is used for strings)
 750
 751            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
 752                Folder to which object is copied
 753
 754            overwrite (bool, optional):
 755                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 756
 757            use_existing (bool, optional):
 758                If an object with the same name exists, a new object with "(1)"/"(2)".. in its loc_name is created.
 759                If use_existing is True and an object with the same name exists, the method just returns the existing object.
 760                Defaults to False.
 761
 762            new_name (str, optional):
 763                New name (if different to original). Defaults to None.
 764
 765            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 766                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be copied. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 767
 768            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 769                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 770
 771            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 772                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 773
 774        Returns:
 775            PFGeneral: Copied object/existing object if overwrite is False
 776        """
 777        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
 778            obj_or_path,
 779            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 780            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 781        )
 782        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 783        if use_existing:
 784            existing_obj = self.get_unique_obj(
 785                obj.GetAttribute("loc_name") + "." + obj.GetClassName(),
 786                parent_folder=target_folder,
 787                error_if_non_existent=False,
 788            )
 789            if existing_obj:
 790                return existing_obj
 791        elif overwrite:
 792            if not new_name:
 793                self.delete_obj(
 794                    obj.GetAttribute("loc_name") + "." + obj.GetClassName(),
 795                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 796                    include_subfolders=False,
 797                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 798                )
 799            else:
 800                self.delete_obj(
 801                    f"{new_name}.{obj.GetClassName()}",
 802                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 803                    include_subfolders=False,
 804                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 805                )
 806        if new_name:
 807            return target_folder.AddCopy(obj, new_name)
 808        else:
 809            return target_folder.AddCopy(obj)
 810
 811    def copy_project(
 812        self,
 813        project_or_path_in_current_user: PFGeneral | str | None = None,
 814        target_folder_or_path_in_current_user: PFGeneral | str | None = None,
 815        overwrite: bool = True,
 816        use_existing: bool = False,
 817        new_name: str = None,
 818        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 819    ) -> IntPrj:
 820        user = self.app.GetCurrentUser()
 821        if project_or_path_in_current_user is None:
 822            project_or_path_in_current_user: IntPrj = self.app.GetActiveProject()
 823        elif isinstance(project_or_path_in_current_user, str):
 824            project_or_path_in_current_user: IntPrj = self.get_unique_obj(
 825                project_or_path_in_current_user, parent_folder=user
 826            )
 827        project_or_path_in_current_user.Deactivate()
 828        if target_folder_or_path_in_current_user is None:
 829            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = user
 830        elif isinstance(target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, str):
 831            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = self.get_unique_obj(
 832                target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, parent_folder=user
 833            )
 834        return self.copy_single_obj(
 835            project_or_path_in_current_user,
 836            target_folder=target_folder_or_path_in_current_user,
 837            overwrite=overwrite,
 838            use_existing=use_existing,
 839            new_name=new_name,
 840            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 841        )

 961    # Delete
 962    ##################
 963    def delete_obj(
 964        self,
 965        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 966        condition: Callable = None,
 967        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, str] = None,
 968        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 969        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 970    ):
 971        """Delete PF object(s).
 972
 973        In a first step, the objects are retrieved using the 'get_obj'
 974        method. In a second step, they are deleted. For further info on the input arguments, see the `get_obj` method. Checks whether objects were really deleted, otherwise tries to deactivate the object and then delete it.
 975
 976        Args:
 977            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]): objects to be deleted.
 978
 979            condition (Callable, optional):
 980                Condition for retrieved object(s). Defaults to None.
 981
 982            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional):
 983                Parent folder used in 'get_obj'. Defaults to None.
 984
 985            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 986                Throw exception if not objects found. Defaults to True.
 987
 988            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Search also in subfolders. Defaults to False.
 989
 990        Raises:
 991            TypeError: If an object cannot be deleted.
 992        """
 993        if obj_or_path:
 994            obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 995                obj_or_path,
 996                condition=condition,
 997                parent_folder=parent_folder,
 998                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 999                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1000            )
1001            for o in obj:
1002                o.Delete()
1003                # 'IsDeleted' seems to be the savest way to check whether an object has been deleted.
1004                if not o.IsDeleted():
1005                    active_study_case = self.__class__.app.GetActiveStudyCase()
1006                    if active_study_case:
1007                        active_study_case.Deactivate()
1008                        o.Delete()
1009                        active_study_case.Activate()
1010
1011                    if not o.IsDeleted():
1012                        try:
1013                            o.Deactivate()
1014                            o.Delete()
1015                        except AttributeError:  # raised when o cannot be deactivated
1016                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")
1017
1018                        if not o.IsDeleted():
1019                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")
1020
1021    def clear_folder(self, folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None):
1022        """Clear all objects inside folder (including hidden objects).
1023
1024        Args:
1025            folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Folder/ container objects or its path. Defaults to None (i.e. '_folder'/active project).
1026        """
1027        folder = (
1028            self._obj
1029            if not folder
1030            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
1031        )
1032        self.delete_obj(
1033            "*",
1034            parent_folder=folder,
1035            include_subfolders=False,
1036            error_if_non_existent=False,
1037        )

1039    ##################
1040    # Attributes
1041    ##################
1042    def get_attr(
1043        self,
1044        obj: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1045        attr: str,
1046        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1047    ) -> Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]:
1048        """Get the value of an attribute of an object.
1049
1050        Args:
1051            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): object or its path
1052            attr (str): attribute name
1053            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
1054                - parent folder of object. Defaults to None.
1055
1056        Raises:
1057            PFAttributeError: If ojbect does not have the specified attribute
1058
1059        Returns:
1060            Union[int|float|str|PFGeneral|list]: Attribute value
1061
1062        Example:
1063            get_attr(terminal_1, "systype")
1064        """
1065        if isinstance(obj, str):
1066            obj = self.get_unique_obj(obj, parent_folder=parent_folder)
1067        try:
1068            if not isinstance(attr, list):
1069                return obj.GetAttribute(attr)
1070            else:
1071                attr_values = dict()
1072                for attribute in attr:
1073                    attr_values[attribute] = obj.GetAttribute(attribute)
1074                return attr_values
1075        except AttributeError as e:
1076            raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
1077
1078    def get_attr_by_path(
1079        self, path_with_attr: str
1080    ) -> Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]:
1081        """Get attribute using the path including the atrribute name
1082
1083        Args:
1084            path_with_attr (str): path including the atrribute name
1085            Example: 'user\\project\\path\\to\\object\\m:Psum:bus1'
1086
1087        Returns:
1088            Union[int|float|str|PFGeneral|list]: Attribute value
1089        """
1090        head_tail = os_path.split(path_with_attr)
1091        return self.get_attr(head_tail[0], head_tail[1])
1092
1093    def set_attr(
1094        self,
1095        obj: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1096        params: dict,
1097        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1098    ) -> None:
1099        """Set the attribute(s) of an object.
1100
1101        Args:
1102            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): PF object
1103            params (dict): attributes and their values (e.g. {'parameter1':value1, 'parameter2':value2,..})
1104            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Parent folder object. Defaults to None.
1105
1106        Raises:
1107            PFAttributeTypeError: If the type of an attribute value is wrong
1108            PFAttributeError: If an object does not have the specified attribute
1109        """
1110        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
1111            obj, parent_folder=parent_folder
1112        )
1113        for attr, value in params.items():
1114            try:
1115                obj.SetAttribute(attr, value)
1116            except TypeError as e:
1117                raise PFAttributeTypeError(obj, attr, e, self)
1118            except AttributeError as e:
1119                raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
1120
1121    def set_attr_by_path(
1122        self, path_with_attr: str, value: Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]
1123    ):
1124        """Set attribute using the path including the attribute name.
1125
1126        Args:
1127            path_with_attr (str): path to ojbect with attribute name at the end
1128            value (Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]): attribute value
1129
1130        Example:
1131          set_attr_by_path(
1132                "Library\\Dynamic Models\\Linear_interpolation\\desc",
1133                ["description"])
1134          Here 'desc' is the name of the attribute.
1135        """
1136        head_tail = os_path.split(path_with_attr)
1137        self.set_attr(head_tail[0], {head_tail[1]: value})
1138
1139    ##################
1140    # Handle
1141    ##################
1142    def _handle_inclusion_of_subfolders(
1143        self,
1144        path: str,
1145        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1146        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1147    ) -> Union[list, PFGeneral]:
1148        """Handle the inclusion of subfolders in search for objects.
1149
1150        If subfolders are included, 'GetChildren' must be used instead of 'GetContents'. 'GetChildren' requires the input to be splitted between path and object name.
1151
1152        Args:
1153            path (str): Path to object(s)
1154
1155            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder,str]): Parent folder where search is started
1156
1157            error_if_non_existent (bool): Raise exception if no objects are found
1158
1159        Raises:
1160            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
1161
1162        Returns:
1163            Union[list, PFGeneral]: Retrieved objects
1164        """
1165        try:
1166            path_folder_list = path.split("\\")
1167            head, tail = "\\".join(path_folder_list[:-1]), path_folder_list[-1]
1168        except AttributeError:
1169            raise TypeError("Path must be of type string.")
1170        if head:
1171            new_parent_folder = parent_folder.GetContents(head)
1172            if new_parent_folder:
1173                parent_folder = new_parent_folder[0]
1174            else:
1175                return self._handle_non_existing_obj(
1176                    head, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
1177                )
1178        return parent_folder.GetChildren(1, tail, 1)
1179
1180    def _handle_non_existing_obj(
1181        self,
1182        path: str,
1183        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1184        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1185    ) -> list:
1186        """Handle the attempted access to a non existent object.
1187
1188        Args:
1189            path (str): path to object
1190
1191            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): search is started from here
1192
1193            error_if_non_existent (bool): raise exception if non existent
1194
1195        Raises:
1196            powfacpy.PFPathError: if 'error_if_non_existent' is True
1197
1198        Returns:
1199            list: empty list if 'error_if_non_existent' is False
1200        """
1201        if not error_if_non_existent:
1202            return []
1203        else:
1204            exists_bool, existing_path, non_existing_child = self.path_exists(
1205                path, parent_folder, return_info=True
1206            )
1207            raise PFPathError(non_existing_child, existing_path)
1208
1209    def _handle_condition_of_obj_not_met(
1210        self,
1211        path: str,
1212        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder],
1213        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1214    ) -> list | None:
1215        """Handle the attempted access to an object with a specific condition, when such object(s) were found, but none of them meets the condition.
1216
1217        Args:
1218            path (str): path of the object(s)
1219
1220            obj (list[Union[PFGeneral, Folder]]): list of objects found using path, but none of them satisfies the condition
1221
1222            error_if_non_existent (bool): raise exception
1223
1224        Raises:
1225            PFNonExistingObjectError: If 'error_if_non_existent' is True
1226
1227        Returns:
1228            list | None: empty list
1229        """
1230        if not error_if_non_existent:
1231            return []
1232        else:
1233            # head, tail = os_path.split(path)
1234            raise PFNonExistingObjectError(parent_folder, path, condition=True)
1235
1236    def _handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
1237        self,
1238        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1239        condition: bool = None,
1240        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1241        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
1242        include_subfolders: bool = False,
1243    ) -> PFGeneral | list[PFGeneral]:
1244        """Handles the input argument 'obj_or_path' when a method accepts either
1245          - a path string
1246          - a PF object
1247          - an iterable (of PF objects)
1248
1249        Note: Unfortunately, it cannot be checked whether 'obj' is a PF DataObject, because the module powerfactory is not available.
1250
1251        See also '_handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input'
1252
1253        Args:
1254            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]): see get_obj
1255
1256            condition (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to None.
1257            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): see get_obj. Defaults to None.
1258
1259            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to True.
1260
1261            include_subfolders (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to False.
1262
1263        Returns:
1264            PFGeneral:
1265                - PF object(s) in a list.
1266                - If 'obj_or_path' is a path string, it returns the PF object(s) of that path.
1267                - If 'obj_or_path' is a PF object (or multiple), it does nothing and just returns the object(s).
1268        """
1269        if isinstance(obj_or_path, str):
1270            return self.get_obj(
1271                obj_or_path,
1272                condition=condition,
1273                parent_folder=parent_folder,
1274                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1275                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1276            )
1277        elif not isinstance(obj_or_path, Iterable):
1278            return [obj_or_path]
1279        elif not isinstance(obj_or_path[0], str):
1280            return obj_or_path
1281        else:
1282            objs = []
1283            for obj in obj_or_path:
1284                objs += self.get_obj(obj)
1285            return objs
1286
1287    def _handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
1288        self,
1289        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1290        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1291        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
1292        include_subfolders: bool = False,
1293    ) -> PFGeneral:
1294        """Handles the input argument when a method accepts either
1295          - a path string
1296          - or a PF object
1297          - but NOT an iterable of PF objects (difference to    _handle_pf_object_or_path_input)
1298
1299        Note: Unfortunately, it cannot be checked whether 'obj' is a PF DataObject, because the module powerfactory is not available.
1300
1301        See also method 'handle_pf_object_path_input'
1302
1303        Args:
1304            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): see get_single_obj
1305
1306            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): get_single_obj. Defaults to None.
1307
1308            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): get_single_obj. Defaults to True.
1309
1310        Raises:
1311            TypeError: If 'obj_or_path' is an iterable (unexpected), a meaningfull error is raised.
1312
1313        Returns:
1314            PFGeneral: If 'obj_or_path' is a path string, it returns the PF object of that path.
1315            If 'obj_or_path' is a PF object, it does nothing and just returns the object.
1316        """
1317        if isinstance(obj_or_path, str):
1318            return self.get_unique_obj(
1319                obj_or_path,
1320                parent_folder=parent_folder,
1321                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1322                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1323            )
1324        elif isinstance(obj_or_path, Iterable) and not isinstance(obj_or_path, Folder):
1325            elements_count = len(obj_or_path)
1326            if obj_or_path:
1327                first_obj_type = type(obj_or_path[0])
1328                try:
1329                    first_obj_path = self.get_path_of_object(obj_or_path[0])
1330                    msg_obj = f"The first element is of type {first_obj_type} and its path is {first_obj_path}."
1331                except AttributeError:
1332                    msg_obj = f"The first element is of type {first_obj_type}."
1333                msg = f"Expected a PowerFactory object or a path string. Instead an iterable of length {elements_count} is given. {msg_obj}"
1334                raise TypeError(msg)
1335            else:
1336                msg = f"Expected a PowerFactory object or a path string. Instead an empty object of type '{type(obj_or_path).__name__}' is given."
1337                raise TypeError(msg)
1338        else:  # If all former conditions are False, it is assumed that the
1339            # input already was a PF object.
1340            return obj_or_path
1341
1342    ######################
1343    # Paths
1344    ######################
1345    def path_exists(
1346        self,
1347        path: str,
1348        parent: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1349        return_info: bool = False,
1350    ) -> bool:
1351        """Check if the path exists.
1352
1353        Args:
1354            path (str): path
1355
1356            parent (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Parent folder where search is started. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj').
1357
1358            return_info (bool, optional): information about where the path is
1359            corrupted is returned. Defaults to False.
1360
1361        Raises:
1362            powfacpy.PFPathInputError: If path is invalid.
1363
1364        Returns:
1365            bool: True if path exists
1366        """
1367
1368        parent = (
1369            self._obj
1370            if not parent
1371            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
1372        )
1373
1374        splitted_path = path.split("\\")
1375        if path[0] == "\\" or not splitted_path:
1376            raise PFPathInputError(path)
1377        existing_path = ""
1378        child = parent
1379        for child_name in splitted_path:
1380            child = child.GetContents(f"{child_name}")
1381            if child:
1382                child = child[0]
1383                existing_path = f"{existing_path}\\{child.loc_name}"
1384            else:
1385                if not return_info:
1386                    return False
1387                else:
1388                    parent_path = parent.GetFullName()
1389                    parent_path = PFStringManipulation.remove_class_names(parent_path)
1390                    existing_path = f"{parent_path}{existing_path}"
1391                    non_existent_child_name = child_name
1392                    return False, existing_path, non_existent_child_name
1393        return True
1394
1395    def get_path_of_object(self, obj: Union[PFGeneral, Folder]) -> str:
1396        """Get path relative to 'self._obj' without class names.
1397
1398        Args:
1399            obj (PFGeneral): PF object
1400
1401        Returns:
1402            str: path
1403        """
1404        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj)
1405        return PFStringManipulation.remove_class_names(
1406            self.get_path_of_obj_with_class_names(obj)
1407        )

1515    def _replace_special_PF_characters_in_path_string(self, path: str) -> str:
1516        """Replaces special characters '$(ExtDataDir)','$(WorkspaceDir)','$(InstallationDir)' in path with their actual directories."""
1517        if "$(ExtDataDir)" in path:
1518            ext_data_dir = self.get_external_data_directory()
1519            path = path.replace("$(ExtDataDir)", ext_data_dir)
1520        path = path.replace("$(WorkspaceDir)", self.get_workspace_directory())
1521        return path.replace("$(InstallationDir)", self.get_installation_directory())

1523    def get_path_between_objects(
1524        self,
1525        obj_high: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1526        obj_low: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1527    ) -> str:
1528        """Get path between two objects in the PF database.
1529
1530        Args:
1531            obj_high (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): object higher in the hierarchy
1532            obj_low (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): object lower in the hierarchy
1533
1534        Returns:
1535            str: path between
1536        """
1537        obj_high = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj_high)
1538        obj_high = self.get_path_of_object(obj_high)
1539        obj_low = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj_low)
1540        obj_low = self.get_path_of_object(obj_low)
1541        path = str(obj_low).split(str(obj_high))[1][1:]
1542        return path

1544    @staticmethod
1545    def get_loc_name_with_class(
1546        objects: Union[PFGeneral, list[PFGeneral]],
1547    ) -> Union[str, list[str]]:
1548        """Get local name (loc_name) including class.
1549
1550        Args:
1551            objects (Union[PFGeneral, list[PFGeneral]]): PF objects(s)
1552
1553        Returns:
1554            Union[str, list[str]]: local name(s)
1555        """
1556        is_list = True
1557        if not type(objects) == list:
1558            objects = [
1559                objects,
1560            ]
1561            is_list = False
1562
1563        loc_name_with_class = []
1564        for powerfactory_object in objects:
1565            loc_name_with_class.append(
1566                powerfactory_object.loc_name + "." + powerfactory_object.GetClassName()
1567            )
1568
1569        if not is_list:
1570            loc_name_with_class = loc_name_with_class[0]
1571        return loc_name_with_class

1581        """Checks whether a PF object is a container. It is assumed

class Folder(powfacpy.base.base.BaseObjectStatic): 
  37class Folder(BaseObjectStatic):
  38    """Class for interacting with folders in the PowerFactory database (any folder in the hierarchy).
  39
  40    The class is very large and has methods to (you can search for sections):
  41        - Get objects (search for '# Get')
  42        - Create objects (search for '# Create')
  43        - Copy objects (search for '# Copy')
  44        - Delete objects (search for '# Delete')
  45        - Get/set attributes (search for '# Attributes')
  46        - Utils to handle user input etc. (search for '# Handle')
  47        - Utils to handle path strings (search for '# Path')
  48        - Other functionality (search for '# Other')
  49
  50    The class is large to have a convenient interface with a lot of functionality to interact with the PF database (at the cost of the clarity of the code unfortunately).
  51
  52    Note that 'app' is a class attribute, i.e. it is shared by all instances. This is convenient because there is only one 'app' object provided by 'powerfactory.GetApplication()'
  53    """
  54
  55    app: PFApp
  56
  57    def __init__(
  58        self, folder: Union[PFGeneral, str], pf_app: PFApp | None | bool = False
  59    ):
  60        """
  61        Args:
  62            folder (Union[PFGeneral, str]): folder object or path in active project (or in active user if no project is active)
  63            pf_app (PFApp | None | bool, optional): Powerfactory app (returned by GetApplication). Defaults to False (does not default to None because None is returned by GetApplication if something goes wrong; Therefore, None should raise an exception).
  64
  65        Raises:
  66            TypeError: When pf_app is None. See explanation of argument 'pf_app'.
  67        """
  68        if pf_app:
  69            self.__class__.app = pf_app
  70        elif pf_app is None:
  71            raise TypeError(
  72                "The input app is of type 'NoneType'. Maybe the PowerFactory app was not loaded correctly."
  73            )
  74        if not isinstance(folder, str):
  75            self._obj = folder
  76        else:
  77            super().__init__(self.__class__.app.GetActiveProject())
  78            if not self._obj:  # Fallback if no project is active
  79                self._obj = self.__class__.app.GetCurrentUser()
  80            self._obj: PFGeneral = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
  81
  82    @property
  83    def folder_obj(self):
  84        return self._obj
  85
  86    @property
  87    def obj(self) -> PFGeneral:
  88        return self._obj
  89
  90    def __getitem__(self, obj: str) -> PFGeneral:
  91        """Allows to call 'get_obj' (without optional arguments, i.e. subfolders are included) using brackets.
  92
  93        Example: terminals = folder_instance['*.ElmTerm']
  94            where folder_instance is an instance of this class.
  95
  96        Args:
  97            obj (str): Object(s) to search for
  98
  99        Returns:
 100            PFGeneral: Pointers to object(s) from the PF database
 101        """
 102        return self.get_obj(obj, include_subfolders=True)
 103
 104    def __iter__(self) -> Generator:
 105        for obj in self.get_obj(
 106            "*", include_subfolders=False, error_if_non_existent=False
 107        ):
 108            yield obj
 109
 110    def __str__(self) -> str:
 111        return str(self._obj)
 112
 113    def __len__(self) -> int:
 114        return len(self._obj.GetContents("*"))

 157    ##################
 158    # Get
 159    ##################
 160    def get_obj(
 161        self,
 162        path: str,
 163        condition: Callable | None = None,
 164        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] | None = None,
 165        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 166        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 167    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 168        """Get the PowerFactory object(s) under 'path'. By default, 'path' is relative to 'self._obj' (or the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject).
 169
 170        See also 'get_unique_obj'.
 171
 172        Args:
 173            path (str): path to object(s), can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
 174
 175            condition (Callable, optional): filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110; defaults to None
 176
 177            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder'); defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
 178
 179            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): raise exception if no objects are found; defaults to True
 180
 181            include_subfolders (bool, optional): include subfolders in the search; defaults to True
 182
 183        Raises:
 184            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
 185
 186        Returns:
 187            list[PFGeneral]: List with PF objects
 188
 189        Examples:
 190          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\Terminal 1")
 191
 192        The path can also start with "\\" and contain wildcards after last "\\":
 193          get_obj("\\Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm")
 194
 195        With condition:
 196          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm"",
 197            condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
 198
 199        Note that you can also use "r" at the beginning of the string
 200        argument to use single "\".
 201        """
 202        parent_folder = (
 203            self._obj
 204            if not parent_folder
 205            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
 206                parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
 207            )
 208        )
 209
 210        if not include_subfolders:
 211            try:
 212                obj = parent_folder.GetContents(path)
 213            except RuntimeError:
 214                raise TypeError("Path must be of type string.")
 215        else:
 216            obj = self._handle_inclusion_of_subfolders(
 217                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 218            )
 219        if not obj:
 220            return self._handle_non_existing_obj(
 221                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 222            )
 223        if condition:
 224            obj_with_condition = self.get_by_condition(obj, condition)
 225            if obj_with_condition:
 226                return obj_with_condition
 227            else:
 228                return self._handle_condition_of_obj_not_met(
 229                    path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
 230                )
 231        else:
 232            return obj
 233
 234    def get_obj_including_subfolders(
 235        self,
 236        path: str,
 237        condition: Callable | None = None,
 238        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] | None = None,
 239        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 240    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 241        """Call 'get_obj' including subfolders."""
 242        return self.get_obj(
 243            path,
 244            condition=condition,
 245            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 246            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 247            include_subfolders=True,
 248        )
 249
 250    def get_obj_partial(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Callable:
 251        """Partial evaluation of 'get_obj'.
 252
 253        Returns a callable to get_obj.
 254
 255        Example: a = get_obj_lazy("path\\to\\obj", error_if_non_existent=False)
 256                 a() # This calls 'get_obj' with given arguments
 257
 258        For further information arguments etc. see 'get_obj'.
 259        """
 260        return partial(self.get_obj, *args, **kwargs)
 261
 262    def get_unique_obj(
 263        self,
 264        path: str,
 265        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 266        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 267        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 268    ) -> PFGeneral | None:
 269        """Get unique PowerFactory object under 'path'.
 270
 271        Use this method if you want to access one single unique object.
 272        This method is an alternative to 'get_obj' and returns the unique object instead of a list (that needs to be accessed with '[0]'). It also checks whether the found object is unique (only one object is found).
 273
 274        Args:
 275            path (str): path to object(s);
 276            can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
 277
 278            condition (Callable, optional):
 279            filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110;
 280            defaults to None
 281
 282            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 283            specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder');
 284            defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
 285
 286            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 287            raise exception if no objects are found;
 288            defaults to True
 289
 290            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 291            include subfolders in the search;
 292            defaults to True
 293
 294        Raises:
 295            TypeError:
 296            If 'path' is not a string.
 297            If several objects were found.
 298
 299        Returns:
 300            PFGeneral: PF object
 301        """
 302        obj = self.get_obj(
 303            path,
 304            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 305            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 306            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 307        )
 308        if obj:
 309            if len(obj) < 2:
 310                return obj[0]
 311            else:
 312                if parent_folder:
 313                    parent_folder_str = (
 314                        f" in '{self.get_path_of_object(parent_folder)}'"
 315                    )
 316                else:
 317                    parent_folder_str = ""
 318                raise TypeError(
 319                    f"The path {path+parent_folder_str} is not a unique object. Did you use wildcards ('*')? This method only returns single unique objects."
 320                )
 321        else:
 322            return None
 323
 324    def get_single_obj(
 325        self,
 326        path: str,
 327        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 328        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 329        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 330    ) -> PFGeneral | None:
 331        """DEPRECATED: Use 'get_unique_obj' instead.
 332
 333        Get unique PowerFactory object under 'path'.
 334
 335        Use this method if you want to access one single unique object.
 336        This method is an alternative to 'get_obj' and returns the unique object instead of a list (that needs to be accessed with '[0]'). It also checks whether the found object is unique (only one object is found).
 337
 338        Args:
 339            path (str): path to object(s);
 340            can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
 341
 342            condition (Callable, optional):
 343            filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110;
 344            defaults to None
 345
 346            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 347            specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relativ to 'parent_folder');
 348            defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
 349
 350            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 351            raise exception if no objects are found;
 352            defaults to True
 353
 354            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 355            include subfolders in the search;
 356            defaults to True
 357
 358        Raises:
 359            TypeError:
 360            If 'path' is not a string.
 361            If several objects were found.
 362
 363        Returns:
 364            PFGeneral: PF object
 365        """
 366        return self.get_unique_obj(
 367            path,
 368            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 369            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 370            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 371        )
 372
 373    def get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
 374        self, parent_folders: Union[list[PFGeneral], str], sub_path: str
 375    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 376        """Get multiple objects that are in a similar subdirectory relativ to
 377        their parent folders
 378
 379        Args:
 380            parent_folders (Union[list[PFGeneral], str]): parent folders
 381
 382            sub_path (str):
 383                path within the parent folders (string). Must be  unique (don't use placeholders '*')
 384
 385        Returns:
 386            list[PFGeneral]: list of PF objects
 387
 388        Example:
 389          If you want to get the "All calculation" objects of all the study cases in the study case folder, use
 390            'self.get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
 391              'Study Cases\\','All calculations')'
 392        """
 393        if isinstance(parent_folders, str):
 394            parent_folders = self.get_obj(parent_folders)
 395        objs = []
 396        for parent in parent_folders:
 397            parent = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
 398            objs.append(self.get_single_obj(sub_path, parent_folder=parent))
 399        return objs
 400
 401    def get_upstream_obj(
 402        self,
 403        start_obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 404        condition: Callable,
 405        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 406    ) -> PFGeneral:
 407        """Get upstream object that meets the condition.
 408
 409        Searches upstream in the PF database hierarchy.
 410
 411        Args:
 412            start_obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional): Object/folder (or its path) to start from
 413
 414            condition (Callable): Condition for the searched object
 415
 416            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): If True, an exception is raised if no upstream object is found. Defaults to True.
 417
 418        Returns:
 419            PFGeneral: The PF object found
 420        """
 421        start_obj_or_path = (
 422            self._obj
 423            if not start_obj_or_path
 424            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(start_obj_or_path)
 425        )
 426        obj_or_path = start_obj_or_path.GetParent()
 427        if obj_or_path:
 428            if condition(obj_or_path):
 429                return obj_or_path
 430            else:
 431                return self.get_upstream_obj(
 432                    obj_or_path, condition, error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent
 433                )
 434        else:
 435            if error_if_non_existent:
 436                raise Exception(
 437                    "There is no upstream object that fullfills the condition."
 438                )
 439            else:
 440                return None
 441
 442    def get_by_condition(
 443        self, objects: list[PFGeneral], condition: Callable
 444    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 445        """Get objects (from a list of objects) which satisfy 'condition'.
 446
 447        Args:
 448            objects (list[PFGeneral]): list of objects
 449            condition (Callable): e.g. lambda function
 450
 451        Raises:
 452            PFAttributeError: If 'condition' queries attributes which an item in 'objects' does not have.
 453            TypeError: ToDo
 454
 455        Returns:
 456            list[PFGeneral]: PF objects
 457
 458        Example:
 459          pfbi.get_by_condition(list_of_objects, lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
 460        """
 461        try:
 462            return [x for x in objects if condition(x)]
 463        except:  # Check where exactly the exception is raised
 464            objects_true = []
 465            for obj in objects:
 466                try:
 467                    # This anonymous function is problematic because it does
 468                    # not always throw an error when the user provided
 469                    # an anonymous function that does not make sense.
 470                    if condition(obj):
 471                        objects_true.append(obj)
 472                except AttributeError as e:
 473                    raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
 474                except TypeError as e:
 475                    object_str = self.get_path_of_object(obj)
 476                    raise TypeError(
 477                        f"{e}. Maybe an unexpected type is used "
 478                        f"for attribute of object '{object_str}'."
 479                    )
 480            return objects_true  # should never be reached
 481
