 499    # Create
 500    ##################
 501    def create_by_path(
 502        self, path: str, overwrite: bool = True, use_existing: bool = False
 503    ) -> PFGeneral:
 504        """Create an object by specifying its path (including the class at the end) and return the object.
 505
 506        Args:
 507            path (str): path including class name at the end.
 508            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite existing object. Defaults to True.
 509
 510        Raises:
 511            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
 512
 513        Returns:
 514            PFGeneral: The created object
 515
 516        Example:
 517          pfbi.create_by_path('Library\\Dynamic Models\\dummy.BlkDef')
 518        """
 519        try:
 520            folder_path, obj_name_incl_class = path.rsplit("\\", 1)
 521        except AttributeError:
 522            raise TypeError("The argument 'path' must be of type string.")
 523        folder = self.get_unique_obj(folder_path)
 524        return self.create_in_folder(
 525            obj_name_incl_class, folder, overwrite=overwrite, use_existing=use_existing
 526        )
 527
 528    def create_in_folder(
 529        self,
 530        obj: str,
 531        folder: PFGeneral | Folder | str = None,
 532        overwrite: bool = True,
 533        use_existing: bool = False,
 534    ) -> PFGeneral:
 535        """Create an object inside a folder and return the object.
 536
 537        Args:
 538            obj (str): obj including class, e.g. 'model.BlkDef'
 539
 540            folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Target folder. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj')
 541
 542            overwrite (bool, optional): objects with the same name will be overwritten. Defaults to True.
 543
 544            use_existing (bool, optional):
 545                If an object with the same name exists, a new object with "(1)"/"(2)".. in its loc_name is created.
 546                If use_existing is True and an object with the same name exists, the method just returns the existing object.
 547                Defaults to False.
 548
 549        Raises:
 550            TypeError: If 'obj' is not a string
 551
 552        Returns:
 553            PFGeneral: The created object
 554
 555        Example:
 556          folder.create_in_folder("dummy2.BlkDef", "Library\\Dynamic Models",)
 557        """
 558        folder = (
 559            self._obj
 560            if not folder
 561            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
 562        )
 563        try:
 564            obj_name, _, class_name = obj.rpartition(".")
 565        except AttributeError:
 566            raise TypeError("The argument 'obj' must be of type string.")
 567        if use_existing:
 568            existing_obj = self.get_unique_obj(
 569                obj, parent_folder=folder, error_if_non_existent=False
 570            )
 571            if existing_obj:
 572                return existing_obj
 573        elif overwrite:
 574            self.delete_obj(
 575                obj,
 576                parent_folder=folder,
 577                include_subfolders=False,
 578                error_if_non_existent=False,
 579            )
 580        return folder.CreateObject(class_name, obj_name)
 581
 582    def create_directory(
 583        self, directory: str, parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None
 584    ) -> IntFolder:
 585        """Create a directory of folders ('IntFolder') if the directory does not exist yet.
 586
 587        Similar to 'mkdir' command in Windows.
 588
 589        Args:
 590            directory (str): path with folders
 591                Example: 'folder1\\folder2\\folder3'
 592
 593            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Folder to start from. Defaults to None.
 594
 595        Returns:
 596            IntFolder: the folder in the lowest subdirectory.
 597        """
 598        if not self.path_exists(directory, parent=parent_folder):
 599            folder = self._obj if not parent_folder else parent_folder
 600            folder_names = directory.split("\\")
 601            for folder_name in folder_names:
 602                if not self.path_exists(folder_name, parent=folder):
 603                    folder = self.create_in_folder(folder_name + ".IntFolder", folder)
 604                else:
 605                    folder = self.get_unique_obj(
 606                        folder_name, parent_folder=folder, include_subfolders=False
 607                    )
 608            return folder
 609        else:
 610            return self.get_unique_obj(
 611                directory, parent_folder=parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
 612            )
 613
 614    def create_filter_obj(
 615        self,
 616        name: str,
 617        folder: str | PFGeneral,
 618        object_filter: str,
 619        look_in: PFGeneral | str,
 620        expression: str,
 621        include_subfolders: bool = True,
 622        only_calc_relevant_obj: bool = False,
 623        overwrite=True,
 624        use_existing=False,
 625    ) -> SetFilt:
 626        """Create filter object (SetFilt)
 627
 628        Args:
 629            name (str): Name of filter object.
 630
 631            folder (PFGeneral | Folder | str): target folder where filer is created.
 632
 633            object_filter (str): Object/class filter (parameter 'objset'). Class names sparated by commas, e.g. '*.ElmTerm, *.ElmLne'.
 634
 635            look_in (PFGeneral | str): Folder from which search is started (parameter 'pstart').
 636
 637            expression (str): filter expression (parameter 'expr'), e.g. 'uknom>100.and.uknom<380.and.iUsage=0'
 638
 639            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Include subfolders in search. Defaults to True.
 640
 641            only_calc_relevant_obj (bool, optional): Search only for calc. relevant objects. Defaults to True.
 642
 643            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite possible existing filter object. Defaults to True.
 644
 645            use_existing (bool, optional): See description of 'create_in_folder' in 'Folder' class of powfacpy. Defaults to False.
 646
 647        Returns:
 648            SetFilt: Filter object
 649        """
 650
 651        filter_obj: SetFilt = self.create_in_folder(
 652            name + ".SetFilt",
 653            folder=folder,
 654            overwrite=overwrite,
 655            use_existing=use_existing,
 656        )
 657        look_in = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(look_in)
 658        filter_obj.objset = [object_filter]
 659        filter_obj.expr = expression
 660        filter_obj.pstart = look_in
 661        filter_obj.isubfold = include_subfolders
 662        filter_obj.icalcrel = only_calc_relevant_obj
 663        return filter_obj
 664
 665    ##################
 666    # Copy
 667    ##################
 668    def copy_obj(
 669        self,
 670        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str, list[PFGeneral]],
 671        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder],
 672        overwrite: bool = True,
 673        condition: Callable = None,
 674        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 675        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 676        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 677    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
 678        """Copy object(s) to 'target_folder'.
 679
 680        Uses 'get_obj' to get the objects under 'obj_or_path'. Source and target must be in the active project (otherwise use PasteCopy(), see scripting reference)
 681
 682        See also 'copy_single_obj'.
 683
 684        Args:
 685            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
 686                Objects to be copied (get_obj is used for strings)
 687
 688            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
 689                Folder to which objects are copied
 690
 691            overwrite (bool, optional):
 692                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 693
 694            condition (Callable, optional):
 695                Condition used in 'get_obj' for the source objects . Defaults to None.
 696
 697            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 698                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be copied. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 699
 700            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 701                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 702
 703            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 704                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 705
 706        Returns:
 707            list[PFGeneral]: Copied objects
 708        """
 709        obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 710            obj_or_path,
 711            condition=condition,
 712            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 713            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 714            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 715        )
 716        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 717        if overwrite:
 718            for object_to_be_copied in obj:
 719                self.delete_obj(
 720                    object_to_be_copied.GetAttribute("loc_name")
 721                    + "."
 722                    + object_to_be_copied.GetClassName(),
 723                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 724                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 725                )
 726        # AddCopy() accepts a list of objects, but then it returns the target folder object and not the copied objects. Therefore, it is iterated through the objects.
 727        copied_obj = []
 728        for o in obj:
 729            copied_obj.append(target_folder.AddCopy(o))
 730        return copied_obj
 731
 732    def copy_single_obj(
 733        self,
 734        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 735        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
 736        overwrite: bool = True,
 737        use_existing: bool = False,
 738        new_name: str = None,
 739        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 740        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 741    ) -> PFGeneral:
 742        """Copy a single PF object to 'target_folder'
 743
 744         Uses 'get_unique_obj' to get the object under 'obj_or_path'. Source and target must be in the active project (otherwise use PasteCopy(), see scripting reference)
 745
 746        See also 'copy_obj'.
 747
 748        Args:
 749            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
 750                Object to be copied (get_unique_obj is used for strings)
 751
 752            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
 753                Folder to which object is copied
 754
 755            overwrite (bool, optional):
 756                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 757
 758            use_existing (bool, optional):
 759                If an object with the same name exists, a new object with "(1)"/"(2)".. in its loc_name is created.
 760                If use_existing is True and an object with the same name exists, the method just returns the existing object.
 761                Defaults to False.
 762
 763            new_name (str, optional):
 764                New name (if different to original). Defaults to None.
 765
 766            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 767                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be copied. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 768
 769            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 770                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 771
 772            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 773                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 774
 775        Returns:
 776            PFGeneral: Copied object/existing object if overwrite is False
 777        """
 778        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
 779            obj_or_path,
 780            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 781            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 782        )
 783        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 784        if use_existing:
 785            existing_obj = self.get_unique_obj(
 786                obj.GetAttribute("loc_name") + "." + obj.GetClassName(),
 787                parent_folder=target_folder,
 788                error_if_non_existent=False,
 789            )
 790            if existing_obj:
 791                return existing_obj
 792        elif overwrite:
 793            if not new_name:
 794                self.delete_obj(
 795                    obj.GetAttribute("loc_name") + "." + obj.GetClassName(),
 796                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 797                    include_subfolders=False,
 798                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 799                )
 800            else:
 801                self.delete_obj(
 802                    f"{new_name}.{obj.GetClassName()}",
 803                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 804                    include_subfolders=False,
 805                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 806                )
 807        if new_name:
 808            return target_folder.AddCopy(obj, new_name)
 809        else:
 810            return target_folder.AddCopy(obj)
 811
 812    def copy_project(
 813        self,
 814        project_or_path_in_current_user: PFGeneral | str | None = None,
 815        target_folder_or_path_in_current_user: PFGeneral | str | None = None,
 816        overwrite: bool = True,
 817        use_existing: bool = False,
 818        new_name: str = None,
 819        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 820    ) -> IntPrj:
 821        user = self.app.GetCurrentUser()
 822        if project_or_path_in_current_user is None:
 823            project_or_path_in_current_user: IntPrj = self.app.GetActiveProject()
 824        elif isinstance(project_or_path_in_current_user, str):
 825            project_or_path_in_current_user: IntPrj = self.get_unique_obj(
 826                project_or_path_in_current_user, parent_folder=user
 827            )
 828        project_or_path_in_current_user.Deactivate()
 829        if target_folder_or_path_in_current_user is None:
 830            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = user
 831        elif isinstance(target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, str):
 832            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = self.get_unique_obj(
 833                target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, parent_folder=user
 834            )
 835        return self.copy_single_obj(
 836            project_or_path_in_current_user,
 837            target_folder=target_folder_or_path_in_current_user,
 838            overwrite=overwrite,
 839            use_existing=use_existing,
 840            new_name=new_name,
 841            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 842        )

 859
 860        Uses 'get_obj' to get the objects under 'obj_or_path'. Target must be in the active project.

 862        See also 'move_single_obj'.

 871            overwrite (bool, optional):
 872                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 873
 874            condition (Callable, optional):
 875                Condition used in 'get_obj' for the source objects . Defaults to None.
 876

 878                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be moved. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 879
 880            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 881                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 882

 884                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 885
 886        Returns:
 887            bool: 0 on success, 1 on error
 888        """
 889        obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 890            obj_or_path,
 891            condition=condition,
 892            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 893            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 894            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 895        )
 896        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 897        if overwrite:
 898            for object_to_be_copied in obj:
 899                self.delete_obj(
 900                    object_to_be_copied.GetAttribute("loc_name")
 901                    + "."
 902                    + object_to_be_copied.GetClassName(),
 903                    parent_folder=target_folder,
 904                    error_if_non_existent=False,
 905                )
 906        return target_folder.Move(obj)

 908    def move_single_obj(
 909        self,
 910        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 911        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
 912        overwrite: bool = True,
 913        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
 914        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 915        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 916    ) -> int:
 917        """Move single PF object to 'target_folder'.
 918
 919        Uses 'get_obj' to get the objects under 'obj_or_path'. Target must be in the active project.
 920
 921        See also 'move_obj'.
 922
 923        Args:
 924            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
 925                Object to be moved (get_unique_obj is used for strings)
 926
 927            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
 928                Folder to which objects are moved
 929
 930            overwrite (bool, optional):
 931                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
 932
 933            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
 934                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be moved. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
 935
 936            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 937                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
 938
 939            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
 940                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
 941
 942        Returns:
 943            bool: 0 on success, 1 on error
 944        """
 945
 946        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
 947            obj_or_path,
 948            parent_folder=parent_folder,
 949            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
 950            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
 951        )
 952        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
 953        if overwrite:
 954            self.delete_obj(
 955                obj.GetAttribute("loc_name") + "." + obj.GetClassName(),
 956                parent_folder=target_folder,
 957                error_if_non_existent=False,
 958            )
 959        return target_folder.Move(obj)
 960
 961    ##################
 962    # Delete
 963    ##################
 964    def delete_obj(
 965        self,
 966        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 967        condition: Callable = None,
 968        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, str] = None,
 969        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 970        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 971    ):
 972        """Delete PF object(s).
 973
 974        In a first step, the objects are retrieved using the 'get_obj'
 975        method. In a second step, they are deleted. For further info on the input arguments, see the `get_obj` method. Checks whether objects were really deleted, otherwise tries to deactivate the object and then delete it.
 976
 977        Args:
 978            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]): objects to be deleted.
 979
 980            condition (Callable, optional):
 981                Condition for retrieved object(s). Defaults to None.
 982
 983            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional):
 984                Parent folder used in 'get_obj'. Defaults to None.
 985
 986            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 987                Throw exception if not objects found. Defaults to True.
 988
 989            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Search also in subfolders. Defaults to False.
 990
 991        Raises:
 992            TypeError: If an object cannot be deleted.
 993        """
 994        if obj_or_path:
 995            obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 996                obj_or_path,
 997                condition=condition,
 998                parent_folder=parent_folder,
 999                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1000                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1001            )
1002            for o in obj:
1003                o.Delete()
1004                # 'IsDeleted' seems to be the savest way to check whether an object has been deleted.
1005                if not o.IsDeleted():
1006                    active_study_case = self.__class__.app.GetActiveStudyCase()
1007                    if active_study_case:
1008                        active_study_case.Deactivate()
1009                        o.Delete()
1010                        active_study_case.Activate()
1011
1012                    if not o.IsDeleted():
1013                        try:
1014                            o.Deactivate()
1015                            o.Delete()
1016                        except AttributeError:  # raised when o cannot be deactivated
1017                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")
1018
1019                        if not o.IsDeleted():
1020                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")
1021
1022    def clear_folder(self, folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None):
1023        """Clear all objects inside folder (including hidden objects).
1024
1025        Args:
1026            folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Folder/ container objects or its path. Defaults to None (i.e. '_folder'/active project).
1027        """
1028        folder = (
1029            self._obj
1030            if not folder
1031            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
1032        )
1033        self.delete_obj(
1034            "*",
1035            parent_folder=folder,
1036            include_subfolders=False,
1037            error_if_non_existent=False,
1038        )
1039
1040    ##################
1041    # Attributes
1042    ##################
1043    def get_attr(
1044        self,
1045        obj: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1046        attr: str,
1047        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1048    ) -> Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]:
1049        """Get the value of an attribute of an object.
1050
1051        Args:
1052            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): object or its path
1053            attr (str): attribute name
1054            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
1055                - parent folder of object. Defaults to None.
1056
1057        Raises:
1058            PFAttributeError: If ojbect does not have the specified attribute
1059
1060        Returns:
1061            Union[int|float|str|PFGeneral|list]: Attribute value
1062
1063        Example:
1064            get_attr(terminal_1, "systype")
1065        """
1066        if isinstance(obj, str):
1067            obj = self.get_unique_obj(obj, parent_folder=parent_folder)
1068        try:
1069            if not isinstance(attr, list):
1070                return obj.GetAttribute(attr)
1071            else:
1072                attr_values = dict()
1073                for attribute in attr:
1074                    attr_values[attribute] = obj.GetAttribute(attribute)
1075                return attr_values
1076        except AttributeError as e:
1077            raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
1078
1079    def get_attr_by_path(
1080        self, path_with_attr: str
1081    ) -> Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]:
1082        """Get attribute using the path including the atrribute name
1083
1084        Args:
1085            path_with_attr (str): path including the atrribute name
1086            Example: 'user\\project\\path\\to\\object\\m:Psum:bus1'
1087
1088        Returns:
1089            Union[int|float|str|PFGeneral|list]: Attribute value
1090        """
1091        head_tail = os_path.split(path_with_attr)
1092        return self.get_attr(head_tail[0], head_tail[1])
1093
1094    def set_attr(
1095        self,
1096        obj: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1097        params: dict,
1098        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1099    ) -> None:
1100        """Set the attribute(s) of an object.
1101
1102        Args:
1103            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): PF object
1104            params (dict): attributes and their values (e.g. {'parameter1':value1, 'parameter2':value2,..})
1105            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Parent folder object. Defaults to None.
1106
1107        Raises:
1108            PFAttributeTypeError: If the type of an attribute value is wrong
1109            PFAttributeError: If an object does not have the specified attribute
1110        """
1111        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
1112            obj, parent_folder=parent_folder
1113        )
1114        for attr, value in params.items():
1115            try:
1116                obj.SetAttribute(attr, value)
1117            except TypeError as e:
1118                raise PFAttributeTypeError(obj, attr, e, self)
1119            except AttributeError as e:
1120                raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
1121
1122    def set_attr_by_path(
1123        self, path_with_attr: str, value: Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]
1124    ):
1125        """Set attribute using the path including the attribute name.
1126
1127        Args:
1128            path_with_attr (str): path to ojbect with attribute name at the end
1129            value (Union[int | float | str | PFGeneral | list]): attribute value
1130
1131        Example:
1132          set_attr_by_path(
1133                "Library\\Dynamic Models\\Linear_interpolation\\desc",
1134                ["description"])
1135          Here 'desc' is the name of the attribute.
1136        """
1137        head_tail = os_path.split(path_with_attr)
1138        self.set_attr(head_tail[0], {head_tail[1]: value})
1139
1140    ##################
1141    # Handle
1142    ##################
1143    def _handle_inclusion_of_subfolders(
1144        self,
1145        path: str,
1146        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1147        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1148    ) -> Union[list, PFGeneral]:
1149        """Handle the inclusion of subfolders in search for objects.
1150
1151        If subfolders are included, 'GetChildren' must be used instead of 'GetContents'. 'GetChildren' requires the input to be splitted between path and object name.
1152
1153        Args:
1154            path (str): Path to object(s)
1155
1156            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder,str]): Parent folder where search is started
1157
1158            error_if_non_existent (bool): Raise exception if no objects are found
1159
1160        Raises:
1161            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
1162
1163        Returns:
1164            Union[list, PFGeneral]: Retrieved objects
1165        """
1166        try:
1167            path_folder_list = path.split("\\")
1168            head, tail = "\\".join(path_folder_list[:-1]), path_folder_list[-1]
1169        except AttributeError:
1170            raise TypeError("Path must be of type string.")
1171        if head:
1172            new_parent_folder = parent_folder.GetContents(head)
1173            if new_parent_folder:
1174                parent_folder = new_parent_folder[0]
1175            else:
1176                return self._handle_non_existing_obj(
1177                    head, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
1178                )
1179        return parent_folder.GetChildren(1, tail, 1)
1180
1181    def _handle_non_existing_obj(
1182        self,
1183        path: str,
1184        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1185        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1186    ) -> list:
1187        """Handle the attempted access to a non existent object.
1188
1189        Args:
1190            path (str): path to object
1191
1192            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): search is started from here
1193
1194            error_if_non_existent (bool): raise exception if non existent
1195
1196        Raises:
1197            powfacpy.PFPathError: if 'error_if_non_existent' is True
1198
1199        Returns:
1200            list: empty list if 'error_if_non_existent' is False
1201        """
1202        if not error_if_non_existent:
1203            return []
1204        else:
1205            exists_bool, existing_path, non_existing_child = self.path_exists(
1206                path, parent_folder, return_info=True
1207            )
1208            raise PFPathError(non_existing_child, existing_path)
1209
1210    def _handle_condition_of_obj_not_met(
1211        self,
1212        path: str,
1213        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder],
1214        error_if_non_existent: bool,
1215    ) -> list | None:
1216        """Handle the attempted access to an object with a specific condition, when such object(s) were found, but none of them meets the condition.
1217
1218        Args:
1219            path (str): path of the object(s)
1220
1221            obj (list[Union[PFGeneral, Folder]]): list of objects found using path, but none of them satisfies the condition
1222
1223            error_if_non_existent (bool): raise exception
1224
1225        Raises:
1226            PFNonExistingObjectError: If 'error_if_non_existent' is True
1227
1228        Returns:
1229            list | None: empty list
1230        """
1231        if not error_if_non_existent:
1232            return []
1233        else:
1234            # head, tail = os_path.split(path)
1235            raise PFNonExistingObjectError(parent_folder, path, condition=True)
1236
1237    def _handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
1238        self,
1239        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1240        condition: bool = None,
1241        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1242        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
1243        include_subfolders: bool = False,
1244    ) -> PFGeneral | list[PFGeneral]:
1245        """Handles the input argument 'obj_or_path' when a method accepts either
1246          - a path string
1247          - a PF object
1248          - an iterable (of PF objects)
1249
1250        Note: Unfortunately, it cannot be checked whether 'obj' is a PF DataObject, because the module powerfactory is not available.
1251
1252        See also '_handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input'
1253
1254        Args:
1255            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]): see get_obj
1256
1257            condition (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to None.
1258            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): see get_obj. Defaults to None.
1259
1260            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to True.
1261
1262            include_subfolders (bool, optional): see get_obj. Defaults to False.
1263
1264        Returns:
1265            PFGeneral:
1266                - PF object(s) in a list.
1267                - If 'obj_or_path' is a path string, it returns the PF object(s) of that path.
1268                - If 'obj_or_path' is a PF object (or multiple), it does nothing and just returns the object(s).
1269        """
1270        if isinstance(obj_or_path, str):
1271            return self.get_obj(
1272                obj_or_path,
1273                condition=condition,
1274                parent_folder=parent_folder,
1275                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1276                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1277            )
1278        elif not isinstance(obj_or_path, Iterable):
1279            return [obj_or_path]
1280        elif not isinstance(obj_or_path[0], str):
1281            return obj_or_path
1282        else:
1283            objs = []
1284            for obj in obj_or_path:
1285                objs += self.get_obj(obj)
1286            return objs
1287
1288    def _handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
1289        self,
1290        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
1291        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1292        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
1293        include_subfolders: bool = False,
1294    ) -> PFGeneral:
1295        """Handles the input argument when a method accepts either
1296          - a path string
1297          - or a PF object
1298          - but NOT an iterable of PF objects (difference to    _handle_pf_object_or_path_input)
1299
1300        Note: Unfortunately, it cannot be checked whether 'obj' is a PF DataObject, because the module powerfactory is not available.
1301
1302        See also method 'handle_pf_object_path_input'
1303
1304        Args:
1305            obj (Union[PFGeneral, str]): see get_single_obj
1306
1307            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): get_single_obj. Defaults to None.
1308
1309            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): get_single_obj. Defaults to True.
1310
1311        Raises:
1312            TypeError: If 'obj_or_path' is an iterable (unexpected), a meaningfull error is raised.
1313
1314        Returns:
1315            PFGeneral: If 'obj_or_path' is a path string, it returns the PF object of that path.
1316            If 'obj_or_path' is a PF object, it does nothing and just returns the object.
1317        """
1318        if isinstance(obj_or_path, str):
1319            return self.get_unique_obj(
1320                obj_or_path,
1321                parent_folder=parent_folder,
1322                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1323                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1324            )
1325        elif isinstance(obj_or_path, Iterable) and not isinstance(obj_or_path, Folder):
1326            elements_count = len(obj_or_path)
1327            if obj_or_path:
1328                first_obj_type = type(obj_or_path[0])
1329                try:
1330                    first_obj_path = self.get_path_of_object(obj_or_path[0])
1331                    msg_obj = f"The first element is of type {first_obj_type} and its path is {first_obj_path}."
1332                except AttributeError:
1333                    msg_obj = f"The first element is of type {first_obj_type}."
1334                msg = f"Expected a PowerFactory object or a path string. Instead an iterable of length {elements_count} is given. {msg_obj}"
1335                raise TypeError(msg)
1336            else:
1337                msg = f"Expected a PowerFactory object or a path string. Instead an empty object of type '{type(obj_or_path).__name__}' is given."
1338                raise TypeError(msg)
1339        else:  # If all former conditions are False, it is assumed that the
1340            # input already was a PF object.
1341            return obj_or_path
1342
1343    ######################
1344    # Paths
1345    ######################
1346    def path_exists(
1347        self,
1348        path: str,
1349        parent: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1350        return_info: bool = False,
1351    ) -> bool:
1352        """Check if the path exists.
1353
1354        Args:
1355            path (str): path
1356
1357            parent (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Parent folder where search is started. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj').
1358
1359            return_info (bool, optional): information about where the path is
1360            corrupted is returned. Defaults to False.
1361
1362        Raises:
1363            powfacpy.PFPathInputError: If path is invalid.
1364
1365        Returns:
1366            bool: True if path exists
1367        """
1368
1369        parent = (
1370            self._obj
1371            if not parent
1372            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
1373        )
1374
1375        splitted_path = path.split("\\")
1376        if path[0] == "\\" or not splitted_path:
1377            raise PFPathInputError(path)
1378        existing_path = ""
1379        child = parent
1380        for child_name in splitted_path:
1381            child = child.GetContents(f"{child_name}")
1382            if child:
1383                child = child[0]
1384                existing_path = f"{existing_path}\\{child.loc_name}"
1385            else:
1386                if not return_info:
1387                    return False
1388                else:
1389                    parent_path = parent.GetFullName()
1390                    parent_path = PFStringManipulation.remove_class_names(parent_path)
1391                    existing_path = f"{parent_path}{existing_path}"
1392                    non_existent_child_name = child_name
1393                    return False, existing_path, non_existent_child_name
1394        return True
1395
1396    def get_path_of_object(self, obj: Union[PFGeneral, Folder]) -> str:
1397        """Get path relative to 'self._obj' without class names.
1398
1399        Args:
1400            obj (PFGeneral): PF object
1401
1402        Returns:
1403            str: path
1404        """
1405        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj)
1406        return PFStringManipulation.remove_class_names(
1407            self.get_path_of_obj_with_class_names(obj)
1408        )
1409
1410    def get_path_of_obj_with_class_names(
1411        self, obj: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]
1412    ) -> str:
1413        """Get path relative to 'self._obj' including class names.
1414
1415        Args:
1416            obj (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): PF object
1417
1418        Returns:
1419            str: path
1420        """
1421        folder_path = self._obj.GetFullName()
1422        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj)
1423        obj_str = obj.GetFullName()
1424        return PFStringManipulation.truncate_beginning(obj_str, folder_path)

1516    def _replace_special_PF_characters_in_path_string(self, path: str) -> str:
1517        """Replaces special characters '$(ExtDataDir)','$(WorkspaceDir)','$(InstallationDir)' in path with their actual directories."""
1518        if "$(ExtDataDir)" in path:
1519            ext_data_dir = self.get_external_data_directory()
1520            path = path.replace("$(ExtDataDir)", ext_data_dir)
1521        path = path.replace("$(WorkspaceDir)", self.get_workspace_directory())
1522        return path.replace("$(InstallationDir)", self.get_installation_directory())
1523
1524    def get_path_between_objects(
1525        self,
1526        obj_high: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1527        obj_low: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str],
1528    ) -> str:
1529        """Get path between two objects in the PF database.
1530
1531        Args:
1532            obj_high (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): object higher in the hierarchy
1533            obj_low (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]): object lower in the hierarchy
1534
1535        Returns:
1536            str: path between
1537        """
1538        obj_high = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj_high)
1539        obj_high = self.get_path_of_object(obj_high)
1540        obj_low = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj_low)
1541        obj_low = self.get_path_of_object(obj_low)
1542        path = str(obj_low).split(str(obj_high))[1][1:]
1543        return path
1544
1545    @staticmethod
1546    def get_loc_name_with_class(
1547        objects: Union[PFGeneral, list[PFGeneral]],
1548    ) -> Union[str, list[str]]:
1549        """Get local name (loc_name) including class.
1550
1551        Args:
1552            objects (Union[PFGeneral, list[PFGeneral]]): PF objects(s)
1553
1554        Returns:
1555            Union[str, list[str]]: local name(s)
1556        """
1557        is_list = True
1558        if not type(objects) == list:
1559            objects = [
1560                objects,
1561            ]
1562            is_list = False
1563
1564        loc_name_with_class = []
1565        for powerfactory_object in objects:
1566            loc_name_with_class.append(
1567                powerfactory_object.loc_name + "." + powerfactory_object.GetClassName()
1568            )
1569
1570        if not is_list:
1571            loc_name_with_class = loc_name_with_class[0]
1572        return loc_name_with_class
1573

1575    # Other
1576    #####################
1577    def is_pf_class(self, class_name: str) -> bool:
1578        """Checks if class_name is a valid PF class (using the class ID)."""
1579        return self.__class__.app.GetClassId(class_name) != 0
1580
1581    def is_container(self, obj: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]) -> bool:
1582        """Checks whether a PF object is a container. It is assumed
1583        that an object is a container if it has the attribute 'contents'.
1584        """
1585        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(obj)
1586        return obj.HasAttribute("contents")
1587
1588    def get_active_project(self) -> IntPrj:
1589        """Get currently active project. Throw an error if no project is active."""
1590        active_project = self.__class__.app.GetActiveProject()
1591        if active_project:
1592            return active_project
1593        else:
1594            raise PFNotActiveError("a project")
1595
1596    def get_current_user(self):
1597        return self.__class__.app.GetCurrentUser()

Class for interacting with folders in the PowerFactory database (any folder in the hierarchy).

The class is very large and has methods to (you can search for sections): - Get objects (search for '# Get') - Create objects (search for '# Create') - Copy objects (search for '# Copy') - Delete objects (search for '# Delete') - Get/set attributes (search for '# Attributes') - Utils to handle user input etc. (search for '# Handle') - Utils to handle path strings (search for '# Path') - Other functionality (search for '# Other')

The class is large to have a convenient interface with a lot of functionality to interact with the PF database (at the cost of the clarity of the code unfortunately).

Note that 'app' is a class attribute, i.e. it is shared by all instances. This is convenient because there is only one 'app' object provided by 'powerfactory.GetApplication()'

Folder( folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, str], pf_app: powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFApp | None | bool = False) 
57    def __init__(
58        self, folder: Union[PFGeneral, str], pf_app: PFApp | None | bool = False
59    ):
60        """
61        Args:
62            folder (Union[PFGeneral, str]): folder object or path in active project (or in active user if no project is active)
63            pf_app (PFApp | None | bool, optional): Powerfactory app (returned by GetApplication). Defaults to False (does not default to None because None is returned by GetApplication if something goes wrong; Therefore, None should raise an exception).
64
65        Raises:
66            TypeError: When pf_app is None. See explanation of argument 'pf_app'.
67        """
68        if pf_app:
69            self.__class__.app = pf_app
70        elif pf_app is None:
71            raise TypeError(
72                "The input app is of type 'NoneType'. Maybe the PowerFactory app was not loaded correctly."
73            )
74        if not isinstance(folder, str):
75            self._obj = folder
76        else:
77            super().__init__(self.__class__.app.GetActiveProject())
78            if not self._obj:  # Fallback if no project is active
79                self._obj = self.__class__.app.GetCurrentUser()
80            self._obj: PFGeneral = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)

def get_obj( self, path: str, condition: Optional[Callable] = None, parent_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder, str, NoneType] = None, error_if_non_existent: bool = True, include_subfolders: bool = False) -> list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral]: 
160    def get_obj(
161        self,
162        path: str,
163        condition: Callable | None = None,
164        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] | None = None,
165        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
166        include_subfolders: bool = False,
167    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
168        """Get the PowerFactory object(s) under 'path'. By default, 'path' is relative to 'self._obj' (or the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject).
169
170        See also 'get_unique_obj'.
171
172        Args:
173            path (str): path to object(s), can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
174
175            condition (Callable, optional): filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110; defaults to None
176
177            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder'); defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
178
179            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): raise exception if no objects are found; defaults to True
180
181            include_subfolders (bool, optional): include subfolders in the search; defaults to True
182
183        Raises:
184            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
185
186        Returns:
187            list[PFGeneral]: List with PF objects
188
189        Examples:
190          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\Terminal 1")
191
192        The path can also start with "\\" and contain wildcards after last "\\":
193          get_obj("\\Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm")
194
195        With condition:
196          pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\\Network Data\\Grid\\*.ElmTerm"",
197            condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
198
199        Note that you can also use "r" at the beginning of the string
200        argument to use single "\".
201        """
202        parent_folder = (
203            self._obj
204            if not parent_folder
205            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
206                parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
207            )
208        )
209
210        if not include_subfolders:
211            try:
212                obj = parent_folder.GetContents(path)
213            except RuntimeError:
214                raise TypeError("Path must be of type string.")
215        else:
216            obj = self._handle_inclusion_of_subfolders(
217                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
218            )
219        if not obj:
220            return self._handle_non_existing_obj(
221                path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
222            )
223        if condition:
224            obj_with_condition = self.get_by_condition(obj, condition)
225            if obj_with_condition:
226                return obj_with_condition
227            else:
228                return self._handle_condition_of_obj_not_met(
229                    path, parent_folder, error_if_non_existent
230                )
231        else:
232            return obj

Get the PowerFactory object(s) under 'path'. By default, 'path' is relative to 'self._obj' (or the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject).

See also 'get_unique_obj'.

Args: path (str): path to object(s), can contain wildcards ("*") after the last ""

condition (Callable, optional): filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110; defaults to None

parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder'); defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject

error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): raise exception if no objects are found; defaults to True

include_subfolders (bool, optional): include subfolders in the search; defaults to True

Raises: TypeError: If 'path' is not a string

Returns: list[PFGeneral]: List with PF objects

Examples: pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\Network Data\Grid\Terminal 1")

The path can also start with "\" and contain wildcards after last "\": get_obj("\Network Model\Network Data\Grid*.ElmTerm")

With condition: pfbi.get_obj("Network Model\Network Data\Grid*.ElmTerm"", condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)

Note that you can also use "r" at the beginning of the string argument to use single "".

def get_unique_obj( self, path: str, parent_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None, error_if_non_existent: bool = True, include_subfolders: bool = False) -> powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral | None: 
262    def get_unique_obj(
263        self,
264        path: str,
265        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
266        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
267        include_subfolders: bool = False,
268    ) -> PFGeneral | None:
269        """Get unique PowerFactory object under 'path'.
270
271        Use this method if you want to access one single unique object.
272        This method is an alternative to 'get_obj' and returns the unique object instead of a list (that needs to be accessed with '[0]'). It also checks whether the found object is unique (only one object is found).
273
274        Args:
275            path (str): path to object(s);
276            can contain wildcards ("*") after the last "\"
277
278            condition (Callable, optional):
279            filter for attributes etc.; example: "condition = lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110;
280            defaults to None
281
282            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
283            specify a parent folder/container (or its path) from where the search is started ('path' is then relative to 'parent_folder');
284            defaults to _folder/the active project folder for instances of PFActiveProject
285
286            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
287            raise exception if no objects are found;
288            defaults to True
289
290            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
291            include subfolders in the search;
292            defaults to True
293
294        Raises:
295            TypeError:
296            If 'path' is not a string.
297            If several objects were found.
298
299        Returns:
300            PFGeneral: PF object
301        """
302        obj = self.get_obj(
303            path,
304            parent_folder=parent_folder,
305            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
306            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
307        )
308        if obj:
309            if len(obj) < 2:
310                return obj[0]
311            else:
312                if parent_folder:
313                    parent_folder_str = (
314                        f" in '{self.get_path_of_object(parent_folder)}'"
315                    )
316                else:
317                    parent_folder_str = ""
318                raise TypeError(
319                    f"The path {path+parent_folder_str} is not a unique object. Did you use wildcards ('*')? This method only returns single unique objects."
320                )
321        else:
322            return None

def get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories( self, parent_folders: Union[list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral], str], sub_path: str) -> list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral]: 
373    def get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
374        self, parent_folders: Union[list[PFGeneral], str], sub_path: str
375    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
376        """Get multiple objects that are in a similar subdirectory relativ to
377        their parent folders
378
379        Args:
380            parent_folders (Union[list[PFGeneral], str]): parent folders
381
382            sub_path (str):
383                path within the parent folders (string). Must be  unique (don't use placeholders '*')
384
385        Returns:
386            list[PFGeneral]: list of PF objects
387
388        Example:
389          If you want to get the "All calculation" objects of all the study cases in the study case folder, use
390            'self.get_multiple_obj_from_similar_sub_directories(
391              'Study Cases\\','All calculations')'
392        """
393        if isinstance(parent_folders, str):
394            parent_folders = self.get_obj(parent_folders)
395        objs = []
396        for parent in parent_folders:
397            parent = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
398            objs.append(self.get_single_obj(sub_path, parent_folder=parent))
399        return objs

def get_upstream_obj( self, start_obj_or_path: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, str], condition: Callable, error_if_non_existent: bool = True) -> powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral: 
401    def get_upstream_obj(
402        self,
403        start_obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
404        condition: Callable,
405        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
406    ) -> PFGeneral:
407        """Get upstream object that meets the condition.
408
409        Searches upstream in the PF database hierarchy.
410
411        Args:
412            start_obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional): Object/folder (or its path) to start from
413
414            condition (Callable): Condition for the searched object
415
416            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional): If True, an exception is raised if no upstream object is found. Defaults to True.
417
418        Returns:
419            PFGeneral: The PF object found
420        """
421        start_obj_or_path = (
422            self._obj
423            if not start_obj_or_path
424            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(start_obj_or_path)
425        )
426        obj_or_path = start_obj_or_path.GetParent()
427        if obj_or_path:
428            if condition(obj_or_path):
429                return obj_or_path
430            else:
431                return self.get_upstream_obj(
432                    obj_or_path, condition, error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent
433                )
434        else:
435            if error_if_non_existent:
436                raise Exception(
437                    "There is no upstream object that fullfills the condition."
438                )
439            else:
440                return None

def get_by_condition( self, objects: list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral], condition: Callable) -> list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral]: 
442    def get_by_condition(
443        self, objects: list[PFGeneral], condition: Callable
444    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
445        """Get objects (from a list of objects) which satisfy 'condition'.
446
447        Args:
448            objects (list[PFGeneral]): list of objects
449            condition (Callable): e.g. lambda function
450
451        Raises:
452            PFAttributeError: If 'condition' queries attributes which an item in 'objects' does not have.
453            TypeError: ToDo
454
455        Returns:
456            list[PFGeneral]: PF objects
457
458        Example:
459          pfbi.get_by_condition(list_of_objects, lambda x : getattr(x,"uknom")==110)
460        """
461        try:
462            return [x for x in objects if condition(x)]
463        except:  # Check where exactly the exception is raised
464            objects_true = []
465            for obj in objects:
466                try:
467                    # This anonymous function is problematic because it does
468                    # not always throw an error when the user provided
469                    # an anonymous function that does not make sense.
470                    if condition(obj):
471                        objects_true.append(obj)
472                except AttributeError as e:
473                    raise PFAttributeError(obj, e, self)
474                except TypeError as e:
475                    object_str = self.get_path_of_object(obj)
476                    raise TypeError(
477                        f"{e}. Maybe an unexpected type is used "
478                        f"for attribute of object '{object_str}'."
479                    )
480            return objects_true  # should never be reached

504        """Create an object by specifying its path (including the class at the end) and return the object.
505
506        Args:
507            path (str): path including class name at the end.
508            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite existing object. Defaults to True.
509
510        Raises:
511            TypeError: If 'path' is not a string
512
513        Returns:
514            PFGeneral: The created object
515
516        Example:
517          pfbi.create_by_path('Library\\Dynamic Models\\dummy.BlkDef')
518        """
519        try:
520            folder_path, obj_name_incl_class = path.rsplit("\\", 1)
521        except AttributeError:
522            raise TypeError("The argument 'path' must be of type string.")
523        folder = self.get_unique_obj(folder_path)
524        return self.create_in_folder(
525            obj_name_incl_class, folder, overwrite=overwrite, use_existing=use_existing
526        )

def create_in_folder( self, obj: str, folder: powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral | Folder | str = None, overwrite: bool = True, use_existing: bool = False) -> powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral: 
528    def create_in_folder(
529        self,
530        obj: str,
531        folder: PFGeneral | Folder | str = None,
532        overwrite: bool = True,
533        use_existing: bool = False,
534    ) -> PFGeneral:
535        """Create an object inside a folder and return the object.
536
537        Args:
538            obj (str): obj including class, e.g. 'model.BlkDef'
539
540            folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Target folder. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj')
541
542            overwrite (bool, optional): objects with the same name will be overwritten. Defaults to True.
543
544            use_existing (bool, optional):
545                If an object with the same name exists, a new object with "(1)"/"(2)".. in its loc_name is created.
546                If use_existing is True and an object with the same name exists, the method just returns the existing object.
547                Defaults to False.
548
549        Raises:
550            TypeError: If 'obj' is not a string
551
552        Returns:
553            PFGeneral: The created object
554
555        Example:
556          folder.create_in_folder("dummy2.BlkDef", "Library\\Dynamic Models",)
557        """
558        folder = (
559            self._obj
560            if not folder
561            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(folder)
562        )
563        try:
564            obj_name, _, class_name = obj.rpartition(".")
565        except AttributeError:
566            raise TypeError("The argument 'obj' must be of type string.")
567        if use_existing:
568            existing_obj = self.get_unique_obj(
569                obj, parent_folder=folder, error_if_non_existent=False
570            )
571            if existing_obj:
572                return existing_obj
573        elif overwrite:
574            self.delete_obj(
575                obj,
576                parent_folder=folder,
577                include_subfolders=False,
578                error_if_non_existent=False,
579            )
580        return folder.CreateObject(class_name, obj_name)

def create_directory( self, directory: str, parent_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None) -> powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.IntFolder: 
582    def create_directory(
583        self, directory: str, parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None
584    ) -> IntFolder:
585        """Create a directory of folders ('IntFolder') if the directory does not exist yet.
586
587        Similar to 'mkdir' command in Windows.
588
589        Args:
590            directory (str): path with folders
591                Example: 'folder1\\folder2\\folder3'
592
593            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Folder to start from. Defaults to None.
594
595        Returns:
596            IntFolder: the folder in the lowest subdirectory.
597        """
598        if not self.path_exists(directory, parent=parent_folder):
599            folder = self._obj if not parent_folder else parent_folder
600            folder_names = directory.split("\\")
601            for folder_name in folder_names:
602                if not self.path_exists(folder_name, parent=folder):
603                    folder = self.create_in_folder(folder_name + ".IntFolder", folder)
604                else:
605                    folder = self.get_unique_obj(
606                        folder_name, parent_folder=folder, include_subfolders=False
607                    )
608            return folder
609        else:
610            return self.get_unique_obj(
611                directory, parent_folder=parent_folder, include_subfolders=False
612            )

def create_filter_obj( self, name: str, folder: str | powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, object_filter: str, look_in: powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral | str, expression: str, include_subfolders: bool = True, only_calc_relevant_obj: bool = False, overwrite=True, use_existing=False) -> powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.SetFilt: 
614    def create_filter_obj(
615        self,
616        name: str,
617        folder: str | PFGeneral,
618        object_filter: str,
619        look_in: PFGeneral | str,
620        expression: str,
621        include_subfolders: bool = True,
622        only_calc_relevant_obj: bool = False,
623        overwrite=True,
624        use_existing=False,
625    ) -> SetFilt:
626        """Create filter object (SetFilt)
627
628        Args:
629            name (str): Name of filter object.
630
631            folder (PFGeneral | Folder | str): target folder where filer is created.
632
633            object_filter (str): Object/class filter (parameter 'objset'). Class names sparated by commas, e.g. '*.ElmTerm, *.ElmLne'.
634
635            look_in (PFGeneral | str): Folder from which search is started (parameter 'pstart').
636
637            expression (str): filter expression (parameter 'expr'), e.g. 'uknom>100.and.uknom<380.and.iUsage=0'
638
639            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Include subfolders in search. Defaults to True.
640
641            only_calc_relevant_obj (bool, optional): Search only for calc. relevant objects. Defaults to True.
642
643            overwrite (bool, optional): Overwrite possible existing filter object. Defaults to True.
644
645            use_existing (bool, optional): See description of 'create_in_folder' in 'Folder' class of powfacpy. Defaults to False.
646
647        Returns:
648            SetFilt: Filter object
649        """
650
651        filter_obj: SetFilt = self.create_in_folder(
652            name + ".SetFilt",
653            folder=folder,
654            overwrite=overwrite,
655            use_existing=use_existing,
656        )
657        look_in = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(look_in)
658        filter_obj.objset = [object_filter]
659        filter_obj.expr = expression
660        filter_obj.pstart = look_in
661        filter_obj.isubfold = include_subfolders
662        filter_obj.icalcrel = only_calc_relevant_obj
663        return filter_obj

def copy_obj( self, obj_or_path: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, str, list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral]], target_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder], overwrite: bool = True, condition: Callable = None, parent_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None, error_if_non_existent: bool = True, include_subfolders: bool = False) -> list[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral]: 
668    def copy_obj(
669        self,
670        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str, list[PFGeneral]],
671        target_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder],
672        overwrite: bool = True,
673        condition: Callable = None,
674        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
675        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
676        include_subfolders: bool = False,
677    ) -> list[PFGeneral]:
678        """Copy object(s) to 'target_folder'.
679
680        Uses 'get_obj' to get the objects under 'obj_or_path'. Source and target must be in the active project (otherwise use PasteCopy(), see scripting reference)
681
682        See also 'copy_single_obj'.
683
684        Args:
685            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]):
686                Objects to be copied (get_obj is used for strings)
687
688            target_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str]):
689                Folder to which objects are copied
690
691            overwrite (bool, optional):
692                Overwrite existing objects. Defaults to True.
693
694            condition (Callable, optional):
695                Condition used in 'get_obj' for the source objects . Defaults to None.
696
697            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional):
698                refers to the source folder and is used in combination with 'obj_or_path' to get the object(s) to be copied. Defaults to  None (i.e. '_folder'/active project is used).
699
700            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
701                Raise error if no (source) objects are found. Defaults to True.
702
703            include_subfolders (bool, optional):
704                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
705
706        Returns:
707            list[PFGeneral]: Copied objects
708        """
709        obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
710            obj_or_path,
711            condition=condition,
712            parent_folder=parent_folder,
713            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
714            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
715        )
716        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
717        if overwrite:
718            for object_to_be_copied in obj:
719                self.delete_obj(
720                    object_to_be_copied.GetAttribute("loc_name")
721                    + "."
722                    + object_to_be_copied.GetClassName(),
723                    parent_folder=target_folder,
724                    error_if_non_existent=False,
725                )
726        # AddCopy() accepts a list of objects, but then it returns the target folder object and not the copied objects. Therefore, it is iterated through the objects.
727        copied_obj = []
728        for o in obj:
729            copied_obj.append(target_folder.AddCopy(o))
730        return copied_obj

812    def copy_project(
813        self,
814        project_or_path_in_current_user: PFGeneral | str | None = None,

816        overwrite: bool = True,
817        use_existing: bool = False,
818        new_name: str = None,
819        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
820    ) -> IntPrj:
821        user = self.app.GetCurrentUser()
822        if project_or_path_in_current_user is None:

830            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = user
831        elif isinstance(target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, str):
832            target_folder_or_path_in_current_user = self.get_unique_obj(
833                target_folder_or_path_in_current_user, parent_folder=user
834            )
835        return self.copy_single_obj(
836            project_or_path_in_current_user,
837            target_folder=target_folder_or_path_in_current_user,
838            overwrite=overwrite,
839            use_existing=use_existing,
840            new_name=new_name,
841            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
842        )

940                Include subfolder in search for source objects. Defaults to False.
941
942        Returns:
943            bool: 0 on success, 1 on error
944        """
945
946        obj = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(
947            obj_or_path,
948            parent_folder=parent_folder,
949            error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
950            include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
951        )
952        target_folder = self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(target_folder)
953        if overwrite:
954            self.delete_obj(

958            )

def delete_obj( self, obj_or_path: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, str], condition: Callable = None, parent_folder: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, str] = None, error_if_non_existent: bool = True, include_subfolders: bool = False): 
 964    def delete_obj(
 965        self,
 966        obj_or_path: Union[PFGeneral, str],
 967        condition: Callable = None,
 968        parent_folder: Union[PFGeneral, str] = None,
 969        error_if_non_existent: bool = True,
 970        include_subfolders: bool = False,
 971    ):
 972        """Delete PF object(s).
 973
 974        In a first step, the objects are retrieved using the 'get_obj'
 975        method. In a second step, they are deleted. For further info on the input arguments, see the `get_obj` method. Checks whether objects were really deleted, otherwise tries to deactivate the object and then delete it.
 976
 977        Args:
 978            obj_or_path (Union[PFGeneral, str]): objects to be deleted.
 979
 980            condition (Callable, optional):
 981                Condition for retrieved object(s). Defaults to None.
 982
 983            parent_folder (Union[PFGeneral, str], optional):
 984                Parent folder used in 'get_obj'. Defaults to None.
 985
 986            error_if_non_existent (bool, optional):
 987                Throw exception if not objects found. Defaults to True.
 988
 989            include_subfolders (bool, optional): Search also in subfolders. Defaults to False.
 990
 991        Raises:
 992            TypeError: If an object cannot be deleted.
 993        """
 994        if obj_or_path:
 995            obj = self._handle_pf_object_or_path_input(
 996                obj_or_path,
 997                condition=condition,
 998                parent_folder=parent_folder,
 999                error_if_non_existent=error_if_non_existent,
1000                include_subfolders=include_subfolders,
1001            )
1002            for o in obj:
1003                o.Delete()
1004                # 'IsDeleted' seems to be the savest way to check whether an object has been deleted.
1005                if not o.IsDeleted():
1006                    active_study_case = self.__class__.app.GetActiveStudyCase()
1007                    if active_study_case:
1008                        active_study_case.Deactivate()
1009                        o.Delete()
1010                        active_study_case.Activate()
1011
1012                    if not o.IsDeleted():
1013                        try:
1014                            o.Deactivate()
1015                            o.Delete()
1016                        except AttributeError:  # raised when o cannot be deactivated
1017                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")
1018
1019                        if not o.IsDeleted():
1020                            raise TypeError(f"Object {o} cannot be deleted.")

def path_exists( self, path: str, parent: Union[powfacpy.pf_classes.protocols.PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None, return_info: bool = False) -> bool: 
1346    def path_exists(
1347        self,
1348        path: str,
1349        parent: Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str] = None,
1350        return_info: bool = False,
1351    ) -> bool:
1352        """Check if the path exists.
1353
1354        Args:
1355            path (str): path
1356
1357            parent (Union[PFGeneral, Folder, str], optional): Parent folder where search is started. Defaults to None (i.e. 'self._obj').
1358
1359            return_info (bool, optional): information about where the path is
1360            corrupted is returned. Defaults to False.
1361
1362        Raises:
1363            powfacpy.PFPathInputError: If path is invalid.
1364
1365        Returns:
1366            bool: True if path exists
1367        """
1368
1369        parent = (
1370            self._obj
1371            if not parent
1372            else self._handle_single_pf_object_or_path_input(parent)
1373        )
1374
1375        splitted_path = path.split("\\")
1376        if path[0] == "\\" or not splitted_path:
1377            raise PFPathInputError(path)
1378        existing_path = ""
1379        child = parent
1380        for child_name in splitted_path:
1381            child = child.GetContents(f"{child_name}")
1382            if child:
1383                child = child[0]
1384                existing_path = f"{existing_path}\\{child.loc_name}"
1385            else:
1386                if not return_info:
1387                    return False
1388                else:
1389                    parent_path = parent.GetFullName()
1390                    parent_path = PFStringManipulation.remove_class_names(parent_path)
1391                    existing_path = f"{parent_path}{existing_path}"
1392                    non_existent_child_name = child_name
1393                    return False, existing_path, non_existent_child_name
1394        return True
